fishing: WHEN: Sat Nov 14 mild fall after good week; cold front possible this weekend may slow some bites. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass / Gasparilla on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish strong under mangroves, oysters and mullet schools; snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead on docks/flats; shrimp/spoons/pinfish working. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, tripletail, bonita, kingfish in 40-50+ ft when seas allow; keeper red grouper deeper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks recent (reds/snook/trout/sheepshead/pompano), FL Sportsman SW Nov 13-15 (great week, redfish solid on live baits/oysters/mangroves).
redtide: FWC Nov 13 status: K. brevis background only in one Pinellas, one Sarasota, one offshore Collier sample past week in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Next report Nov 20.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples Nov 2-3). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~2-149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
